question.prompt: An item of clothing costs 198 yuan, and a hat costs 102 yuan. About how many yuan do they cost altogether? Treat the prices as 200 yuan and 100 yuan to calculate. Calculate: \(200+100=?\)

solutions.explanation: 198 is close to 200, and 102 is close to 100, so the total is about 300 yuan.
solutions.title: Estimate using nearby hundreds
